title: Human Islets - Sample Barcoding Oligos
author: Opentrons
materials: Aspirate and discard 150 μl of supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare waste and pooled wells
steps.instruction: Set the trash container as a waste reservoir for supernatant removal and designate well 12 of the reservoir as the pooled‑sample well; this protocol uses a full 96‑sample plate.

steps.title: Add SBO to each well
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of 0.4 µM sample‑barcoding oligo (SBO) to each well of the 96‑well plate (each SBO is unique to its well).

steps.title: Mix cells in wells
steps.instruction: Pipette the cell suspension up and down 10 times using a pipette set to a 50 µL volume.

steps.title: First wash of cells
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of wash‑resuspension buffer to each well.

steps.title: Centrifuge plate
steps.instruction: Spin the plate at 800 g for 6 minutes.

steps.title: Aspirate supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard 150 µL of supernatant from each well using the waste reservoir.

steps.title: Perform two additional washes
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash‑centrifuge‑aspirate sequence two more times.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µL wash‑resuspension buffer to each well.

steps.title: Pool wells column‑wise and wash first column
steps.instruction: Starting with column 1, pool the cell suspension from each well into the corresponding column of a reagent reservoir. For the first 8‑well column, add 150 µL of Smart‑seq3 lysis buffer (12.5 % PEG 8000, 0.1 % Triton, 0.5 U/µL RNase inhibitor, 1.25 mM dNTP) to each well, pipette up and down, dispense 50 µL of the cell suspension into the reservoir, and transfer the remaining ~150 µL to the next well in the column.

steps.title: Transfer last column to reservoir
steps.instruction: For the final 8‑well column, transfer the entire volume from each well into the reagent reservoir.

steps.title: Repeat pooling and washing twice
steps.instruction: Repeat the entire column‑wise pooling and washing procedure (steps above) two additional times.

steps.title: Transfer pooled suspension to LoBind tube
steps.instruction: Move the combined cell suspension from the reagent reservoir into a 5 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Count cells and adjust concentration
steps.instruction: Count the cells and adjust the suspension to 1,000 cells/µL using Smart‑seq3 lysis buffer.

steps.title: Dispense cells and add negative control
steps.instruction: To each well of a skirted twin.tec 96‑well LoBind plate, add 2 µL of the cell suspension (distribute into 95 wells). Add 2 µL of Smart‑seq3 lysis buffer to one additional well to serve as a negative control.
